title: What AI Can Give Back to a Human Day
desc: A personal reflection on using AI to reduce friction without giving away judgement, privacy or the pleasure of doing things slowly.
alt: A laptop, notebook and cup of tea arranged in a warm workspace.
caption: A workspace for thinking with tools, not surrendering thought. Photograph via Pexels.

title: The Difference Between Assistance and Dependence
desc: A quiet examination of how useful tools can support a person without taking over their attention, judgement or agency.
alt: A laptop and notebook arranged on a quiet desk beside a cup of tea.
caption: A tool can sit beside a life without becoming the life. Photograph via Pexels.

title: The Books That Made Me More Patient
desc: A personal map of books that changed the pace of thought and taught patience as a way of paying attention.
alt: Books arranged beside a porcelain teapot in warm natural light.
caption: Books that make room for a slower kind of attention. Photograph via Pexels.

title: Reading When the World Wants a Summary
desc: A reflection on slow reading, patience and the value of staying with a book before rushing to an opinion.
alt: An open book, a closed red book and a cup of tea in sunlight.
caption: Reading without asking the page to hurry. Photograph via Pexels.

title: Learning to Fail Without Becoming Smaller
desc: Failure can be information without becoming an identity.
alt: An open notebook with handwritten notes and a pen in soft light.
caption: A page can hold what happened without becoming the title of a life. Photograph via Pexels.

title: What Mentoring Has Taught Me About Advice
desc: The best help is often not an answer but a better question.
alt: Two people holding warm drinks across a table during a conversation.
caption: Good advice often begins by making room for another person’s question. Photograph via Pexels.

title: What My Oura Ring Taught Me About Sleep
desc: What a wearable can reveal, what it cannot know and how to avoid letting a score become a judgement.
alt: A dark smart ring resting on a bedside table in warm morning light.
caption: A small ring, a quiet bedside and the question of what our data can teach us. Photograph supplied by Rehana.
